text:
Ranking Member Maxine Waters Responds to Treasury Proposal to Implement Private Equity Housing Ban in Bipartisan ROAD to Housing Act
Washington, DC,
October 22, 2026
Tags:
Today, Congresswoman Maxine Waters (D-CA), the top Democrat on the House Financial Services Committee, issued the following statement in response to the Treasury Department's proposed rule implementing restrictions on large institutional investors purchasing single-family homes under the bipartisan “Today, the Treasury moved forward to implement one of the most important provisions my colleagues and I worked hard to secure in the overwhelmingly bipartisan 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act: stopping Wall Street investors from buying up single-family homes. For too long, billion-dollar corporations have been snatching up homes while hardworking families are priced out of homeownership. We fought to change that, and despite Donald Trump's temper tantrum and refusal to sign our bipartisan bill, we got it done. ### |
